models_evaluated: six LLMs (three open-source, three closed-source) under three agent scaffolds
unlisted_practices: Benchmarking LLM agents on end-to-end observational study execution in a real database (MIMIC-IV) against published study protocols
Automated cohort evaluation to localize agent errors and identify failure modes
Comparing agent scaffolds for effect on task performance

screen.reason: The study introduces RWE-bench, a benchmark evaluating the ability of LLM agents to execute observational research/real-world evidence studies on MIMIC-IV. It evaluates models and agent scaffolds on benchmark tasks rather than testing organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
